# T-1: Route plugin help

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Adjust top-level plugin fallback help handling so contributed plugin commands receive their own `--help` requests while core command shared help still uses metadata.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `senti workflow --help` dispatches to the workflow plugin command.
- `senti workflow` without `--help` still dispatches to the workflow plugin command.
- A nonexistent plugin command `--help` request does not exit successfully.

## Implementation Notes
Change `src/senti.js` around plugin fallback help handling. Preserve existing core and independent command help branches.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local CLI tests run the entry point with plugin command help, plugin command no-subcommand, and unknown command help cases.
